nodes.summary: An $n \times n$ array $M$ of natural numbers, with rows and columns indexed by $0, 1, \dots, n - 1$, is a *magic square* when there is a natural number $s$ such that every row of $M$ and every column of $M$ sums to $s$, and also $\sum_i M_{i,i} = s$ (the main diagonal) and $\sum_i M_{i,n-1-i} = s$ (the anti-diagonal).
nodes.title: Magic squares

nodes.summary: The $3 \times 3$ square with rows $(7, 0, 5)$, $(2, 4, 6)$ and $(3, 8, 1)$, a form of the Lo Shu square with every entry reduced by $1$, is a reduced magic square of order $3$; its magic sum is $12$.
nodes.title: The reduced Lo Shu square

nodes.summary: An $n \times n$ array $M$ of natural numbers is a *reduced magic square of order $n$* when it is a magic square and its entries are $0, 1, \dots, n^2 - 1$, each exactly once; equivalently, every entry of $M$ is less than $n^2$ and distinct cells of $M$ hold distinct entries.
nodes.title: Reduced magic squares

nodes.summary: The $2 \times 2$ square with rows $(0, 1)$ and $(2, 3)$ is not a reduced magic square.
nodes.title: A 2×2 square that is not a reduced magic square

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

stated.label: statement formalized
